answer_1.quote: We adopt text-to-Cypher as the primary graph retrieval approach and develop a benchmark consisting of (question, Cypher) pairs... given the graph schema and a natural language question as input, output an executable Cypher query that returns the desired answer.

answer_2.quote: Execution accuracy, the standard metric in text-to-SQL evaluation, measures whether the results returned by the predicted query match those returned by the ground truth query... We also propose Provenance Subgraph Jaccard Similarity (PSJS) as an isolated measure of the subgraph matching performance.
